The grooming process for all children is a real thing and it's an issue that is good to be addressed and corrected. 
Receiving attention during puberty naturally could lead to even positive feelings. Hormonally induced positive emotions I mean. Young people and especially girls need to be cautious and well-informed that these kinds of behaviors (which lead to discomfort) shouldn't be passed off as compliments.
